decisionsTitle: «Cere reconfirmarea»: «Vin» on the organizers' message, a ready reminder text, and a queue where a staff send steps aside
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11**, on the reminder before the race, in his words:

1. «trebuie să trimit un mail de reminder, custom, în care să poată reconfirma sau anula pentru a da înscrierea mai departe»
2. «și mailul acela către toți participanții trebuie să fie default, dar vreau să fac preview mai întâi»
3. «și trebuie să mă asigur că nu blochez sistemul și trimit în batch-uri având în vedere că voi trimite 200 de mailuri»
4. «și vreau să fac și tracking dacă au apăsat că vin, gen să știu că au „reconfirmat”, dar e opțional»

Of the options put to him he picked «Butonul „Vin”» and «Text de reminder gata scris». What he asked for: a reminder with a ready text that asks who is coming, seen before it goes, and a send of two hundred that never holds up a runner's own emails. What his last sentence means here, kept true on every screen and in every text of this change:

1. the club sees who pressed «Vin»;
2. answering is optional — nothing in a state, a place, a deadline, the allocator or the capacity formula reads the answer;
3. «N-au răspuns» is information for the organizers, not a state;
4. nobody is cancelled automatically: the composer's help line says so, and the ready text says that pressing nothing leaves the registration exactly as it is.

**The two choices this builds.** «Vin» goes on the organizers' own message, «Trimite un mesaj participanților», behind a tick of the send — not on the automatic reminder; and the ready text is a button that fills the boxes, which the organizer may still change before sending.

### Part one: «Cere reconfirmarea», «Vin» and the ready text

**The tick.** The composer gets «Cere reconfirmarea» under the message, its help line «Emailul primește și butonul „Vin”. Nu se anulează nimeni automat; „N-au răspuns” e doar o informație pentru organizatori.» A send with it carries `askReconfirm: true` beside the words in the payload of exactly the rows whose registration it asks — the same `isReconfirmStatus` test at queue time that writes the ask row — so a send has two payloads, with and without the flag, each with its own «Trimite acum» mark (§540); the club's copy carries none. The audit row stays send-wide (`askReconfirm`, `asked`, `askedTest`). The flag is the row's because a send drains over days: an entry that was a waiting-list offer at send — reached by «Toți cei înscriși» but not asked — and accepted its offer before its row rendered would otherwise get «Vin» with no ask behind it, a button landing on a page with no question and a press refused. It gets «Nu mai pot ajunge» alone; a registration asked at send and no longer in an asked state when its row renders gets no «Vin» either (the render-time check in `reconfirmApplies`). The preview draws both buttons — «Vin» and «Nu mai pot ajunge» — on an inert example link (`${APP_BASE_URL}/<locale>/EXAMPLE#…`), as every `/admin/emails` preview does: no token is minted.

**The button.** «Vin» / "I'm coming" is a filled, full-width button in the club's ink blue just above «Nu mai pot ajunge», at least 48 pixels tall, its glyph the manage page's `EventAvailable` in white (`public/brand/email-reconfirm.png`, from `yarn brand:assets`), and one sentence under it: «Ne spui că vii. Nu e obligatoriu.» It uses the manage link the cancel already carries — the same `MANAGE_REGISTRATION` token minted at send time, at `#reconfirm` instead of `#cancel`: no new token purpose, no enum value. It goes only where «Nu mai pot ajunge» goes (the registration's own address, active, the event ahead and running) and only to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration (`RECONFIRM_STATUSES`); never on a club copy (§320). A waiting-list offer gets no «Vin»: its own email asks for the declaration.

**The page.** The manage page draws, for a registration a send asked while the event is ahead, «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» — not «Da, vin», which is the RSVP feature's word (§811) — the line «Răspunsul e opțional: dacă nu apeși nimic, înscrierea rămâne exact cum e.» and the way out, «Nu mai poți ajunge? Folosește „Anulează înscrierea” mai jos.»; a pending declaration gets «Mai ai de semnat declarația: fără ea înscrierea nu e confirmată.», a waiting entry «Ești pe lista de așteptare; locul tău în ea nu se schimbă, oricum ai răspunde.» — never a sentence that makes the press sound like the way to keep a place — and an offer the sentence that points at its email. The GET writes nothing (BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4). The POST reads the manage token through `readActionTokenContext` — the reader «Schimbă adresa» binds to the registration's current participant, so a link sent to an address the registration has left is answered as a missing token and records nothing — and never spends it: the same page still cancels. Per person (§547): a family member of the same address at the same event is accepted, a stranger refused. One transaction locks the registration, checks its state and its event, and answers every open ask of it — the answer is about the event, not one email — once: a second press writes nothing and makes no audit row, the first moment is kept («set, not flip»). A cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a registration nobody asked is answered «Răspunsul nu a fost înregistrat pentru această înscriere.» with nothing written — one sentence true for every refusal, since a registration nobody asked is still active. The audit row is `registration.reconfirmed`, no staff actor, `{ via: "MANAGE_LINK", sends }`, never a name.

**What is recorded.** One table, `registration_reconfirmations` — one row per registration asked per send (`registration_id`, `event_id`, `send_id`, `asked_at`, `reconfirmed_at`), unique per registration and send, cascading with the registration and with the event; migration `0200_registration_reconfirmations`, expand only, nothing backfilled. Written inside the send's own transaction, test registrations too (AGENTS.md §12.6). A table and not columns on `registrations`, because a second send's ask would overwrite the first's numbers; not derived from the outbox, because its sent rows are swept. «Schimbă adresa» re-addresses a waiting message with its payload, so the flag travels with the row; the asks belong to the registration and stay with it.

**What staff see.** The chip «A reconfirmat» (`StatusChip glyph="reconfirmed"`) on a list row whose person said «Vin» and is still registered; the filter «Reconfirmare» — «Au reconfirmat · Au anulat după cerere · N-au răspuns» — one `EXISTS` in the list's one `WHERE`, so its count, its pages, its summary and its export follow it; on each «Mesaje trimise» row of a send that asked, «Au reconfirmat {yes} · Au anulat {cancelled} · N-au răspuns {none}», one grouped query for the whole history, test registrations left out; one line on the registration's page, «A spus că vine {date}.»; the export column «Reconfirmat» after «Partener», «Note interne» still the last; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists each ask and its answer. **One rule for «a reconfirmat», on every screen:** a registration has re-confirmed when any of its asks — this send's or another's of the event — is answered. Of the registrations a send asked, «Au reconfirmat» counts the still registered with some answered ask, «N-au răspuns» the still registered with none, «Au anulat după cerere» those cancelled at or after this send's ask. So a person who pressed «Vin» after the first reminder and stays silent after the second counts under «Au reconfirmat» on both «Mesaje trimise» rows, as the list's chip, its filter and the export's «Reconfirmat» say; the manage page still offers the question while an ask is open. Still one grouped read for the whole history (a correlated `EXISTS` inside the `FILTER`), test registrations left out. An expired registration is in none of the three. A structural guard (`tests/unit/registrations/reconfirmation-never-leaves.test.ts`) keeps the answer off every public page but the person's own manage page, out of the email's renderer (which reads only the flag and the link), the desk, the sponsors' file, the allocator, the capacity formula and the maintenance job.

**The ready text.** «Completează cu textul de reminder», above the subject, writes the four boxes from the catalogues — Romanian into the Romanian boxes and English into the English ones, whatever the backoffice's language, the placeholders literal — and ticks «Cere reconfirmarea»; it asks «Înlocuiești textul scris?» first when a box already holds words. The text: «Ne vedem la {eventTitle}? Spune-ne dacă vii» / "See you at {eventTitle}? Tell us if you're coming", then six paragraphs — the greeting, when and where, «Dacă vii și vezi butonul „Vin” mai jos, apasă-l. Așa știm pe cine așteptăm.» (a waiting-list offer reached by «Toți cei înscriși» gets no «Vin», so the sentence does not promise one), «Dacă nu mai poți ajunge, apasă „Nu mai pot ajunge”, ca locul să poată fi dat cuiva de pe lista de așteptare.», **«Dacă nu apeși nimic, înscrierea ta rămâne exact cum e.»** and the thanks. Every placeholder is one the subject can fill.

### Part two: the queue's order, and what the Administrator is told about a send

**Five steps.** On each road the outbox claims, each step oldest first and in the room the steps before it left: (1) a registration's own messages — every type that is neither a send to many nor bulk; (2) «Detalii actualizate» (`EVENT_UPDATE_NOTICE`); (3) the automatic reminder (`EVENT_REMINDER`); (4) «Trimite un mesaj participanților» (`ORGANIZER_MESSAGE`); (5) the bulk ones under their cap (§445). Steps 2–4 are one constant, `SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES` in `notifications/domain/bulk.ts`: one message per registration of an event, queued by one press or one job; a moved start is more urgent than a reminder, a reminder than an organizers' message. A club copy rides with its type, and `BULK_CLUB_COPY_MESSAGES` again means only which types get one club copy per send. Steps 1–4 have no cap, so one ordered claim takes them; the bulk keeps its own claim for its cap. The same order in Gmail's carried path (Gmail carrying for a stopped Mailgun), for a press's own rows («Trimite acum», §540) and in the batch handed to the worker. A verification queued after a burst of two hundred — or a waiting-list offer queued after the reminder's two hundred, which the maintenance job queues in one transaction a reminder lead before the start — leaves in the next batch, and the burst still drains completely, none sent twice. Nothing drops or stales a reminder that now waits minutes behind the registrations' own messages: its row keeps its once-per-registration key, no render withdraws it for waiting, and the start is a reminder lead away.

**No reserve.** The first build kept `max(10, 10%)` of a daily allowance (10% of a monthly one) for the registrations' own emails: a cap on the staff sends per pass, the rest held until the allowance's reset and marked. The review of the merged tree, with probes, found that the hold could close Mailgun's road until midnight — it kept Mailgun's pause and allowance marks on the rows it moved to the reset, and the stop reader then read Mailgun as stopped, so no verification, offer or confirmation left by Mailgun for up to fifteen hours — that it rang `/api/health` with false «stalled» answers during a normal drain, and that it showed visitors a false «emailurile întârzie»; and on the monthly plan the club is on for the race it would never have acted. Version one therefore orders and tells the truth, and keeps no reserve (decided for the owner, below). Steps 2–4 get no cap, no hold and no mark; the newsletter's own reserve (§445) is unchanged.

**What health and the public pages read.** A send to many waiting past its turn is not late by that alone — on `/api/health` and in the queue panel's «late», one judgement: it waits behind the registrations' own messages and drains at the queue's pace. Probed on a monthly plan with the hourly pace cleared, 201 organizers' messages queued at 10:00 and a pass every fifteen minutes read «stalled» from 11:45 before this change, and `ok` at every pass until the last left at 12:30 now; the reminder's 200 the same. What still catches a real stall: a scheduler that stopped is the job check's; a provider's refusal, pause or stop on such a row is counted by the other buckets — deferred, paused late, stopped late, retrying late, failed — as on any row; a registration's own message whose turn passed is late as before. The public «emailurile întârzie» counts a send to many neither as a message a visitor waits for nor as queued ahead of a new registration's email.

**Before «Trimite».** Worded on the server, on the road the send really takes — the participants' on their group's road, the club's copy on its own:

1. **Mailgun's road, no daily ceiling** (a monthly plan, or none): the pace «Pleacă treptat, câte 20 la 15 minute ziua (noaptea mai rar): cam {hours} ore pe ritmul de zi.» — or «cel mult {hourly} pe oră» when Mailgun's hour is the slower —, «Încape în cota lunii.» or this month's part when it does not fit, and the assurance «Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lor.» / "The registrations' own emails leave before them.".
2. **A daily ceiling** (Free): how many can leave today — what the day's allowance has left less what already waits ahead on Mailgun's road — with the hours of those alone, and the rest at most the allowance a day over at least N more days. When the send does not fit today, a warning in the warning colour, in the dialog and on the composer: «Pe un plan cu cotă zilnică, mesajul acesta ocupă cota zilnică timp de {days} zile. Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lui, dar din aceeași cotă: după ce se termină, așteaptă ziua următoare.» — «… pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului.» only while «Gmail preia când Mailgun se oprește» is in force — «Un mesaj mare se trimite pe un plan lunar: «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Planul Mailgun și cât mai putem trimite».», the labels read from the catalogue. On Free with 5 already sent, 201 messages: 95 today in about two hours, the other 106 over at least two more days at 100 a day, the daily allowance taken three days.
3. **The club's Gmail road**: no Mailgun sentence at all — Gmail's room in the rolling 24 hours, its cap and its pace a pass («Pleacă prin Gmail-ul clubului, câte 4 la 15 minute ziua …»), and how many wait for room under the cap (or leave by Mailgun, when the club set that at Gmail's cap). 201 on a cap of 200: 200 in about thirteen hours, one waits.

The cost line beside the composer follows the same roads: «… — se scad din cota Mailgun …» only for what Mailgun carries, the club's copy said apart when it goes by Gmail, and Gmail's own line on its road. The road the dialog offers to switch (§841) is the group's setting; the line describes that road. No start time is promised: «Când pleacă emailurile» says when the first leaves.

**Progress.** Each «Mesaje trimise» row shows «Au plecat {left} · Așteaptă {waiting}» (and «Nu au plecat {failed}» when some failed), one grouped query over the outbox by send, test registrations left out; hidden once the retention job has swept the sent rows.

### Decided for the owner (the defaults; each can change)

1. **No reserve.** The order keeps the registrations' own emails first on every plan and road; on a daily plan they share the allowance with the send, and the dialog says so before «Trimite». A reserve held rows in a way that could close Mailgun's road and ring false alarms, and would not act on the race month's plan.
2. **The Mailgun plan for the race week: no code change.** `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` item 24 moves Mailgun to Basic on 1 November: on Basic, 201 messages fit the month and leave in about three hours at 20 every 15 minutes, the registrations' own emails first. Should the plan stay on Free, the same 201 leave over three days — 95 today with 5 already sent, then 100 a day — and the dialog warns that the send takes the daily allowance three days, that the registrations' own emails share it, and where the monthly plan is chosen; or «Anunțuri» can go through the club's Gmail on «Setări» → «Emailuri» (its own cap; no Mailgun allowance spent).
3. **«Au anulat după cerere»** counts any cancellation at or after the ask — the participant's or an Administrator's. The alternative was the participant's own only.

### For the lawyer

The privacy notice already covers the organizers' messages (art. 6(1)(b)) and keeps registration data for the registration's life; no legal text or template is changed here. Two sentences for the next review:

1. «Clubul păstrează, la o înscriere, dacă și când participantul a apăsat „Vin” într-un mesaj al organizatorilor; nu schimbă înscrierea și se șterge odată cu ea.»
2. «Nota nu numește încă acest răspuns; o versiune viitoare îl poate numi explicit.»

### Refused in version one

- **An automatic cancel of those who do not answer.** Answering is optional; a missed email must never cost a place.
- **An automatic second reminder.** The club sends another by hand; a job would be a new automatic email.
- **Changing `EVENT_REMINDER`.** It goes to every confirmed registration on its schedule (AGENTS.md §16.3); asking there would ask everybody, every time.
- **Anything on a public page.** Who said «Vin» is the organizers' information, not a disclosure (§10.10).
- **A deadline to answer, or a state for the silent.** «N-au răspuns» is a count, never a status the allocator could read.
- **A reserve on a daily plan.** The first build's hold could close Mailgun's road until midnight, ring false alarms and show visitors a false delay; the order and the warning before «Trimite» tell the truth instead, and on the monthly plan the club is on for the race a reserve would never act.
changelogLine: - **«Cere reconfirmarea» and «Vin»** — a tick on «Trimite un mesaj participanților» puts «Vin» beside «Nu mai pot ajunge» in the email of every registration the send asks; the person's «Da, vin la cursă» on their own page is recorded once, optional and changing nothing, and staff see «A reconfirmat» (any answered ask), a three-way filter, the counts on «Mesaje trimise» and a «Reconfirmat» column; «Completează cu textul de reminder» fills both languages; the outbox now sends a registration's own emails first, then «Detalii actualizate», the automatic reminder and the organizers' messages, the newsletter last, and the question before «Trimite» says how the send leaves on the road it takes, with a warning on a daily plan it does not fit. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an organizer's message sent with «Cere reconfirmarea» to a confirmed, pending-declaration or waiting registration of an event still ahead, when the person opens «Vin» then the manage page's GET asks «Vii la {event}?» with «Da, vin la cursă» and writes nothing; the POST reads the manage token through the reader bound to the registration's current participant, never spends it, records the first moment once (a second press writes nothing and audits nothing) and changes no state, place, hold or deadline; a waiting-list offer, a cancelled or expired registration, an event started or cancelled, or a link of an address the registration has left records nothing (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Cere reconfirmarea», when a send or its preview is asked then only a role that may message the participants (the Organizer and above) is served and every other role is refused FORBIDDEN with no ask written; who said «Vin» is read only by the backoffice's list, the registration's page, «Mesaje trimise», the registrations' Excel and CSV and «Toate datele unei persoane», and by no public page, email, desk, sponsors' file, allocator or capacity term (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send with «Cere reconfirmarea» to «Toți cei înscriși», when its rows render then «Vin» is drawn only in the email of a registration the send asked: the flag is in the payload of exactly the rows that got an ask row (each with its own «Trimite acum» mark, none on the club's copy, the audit send-wide); an entry that was a waiting-list offer at send and accepted it before its row rendered gets «Nu mai pot ajunge», no «Vin» and has no ask row; one asked at send and no longer in an asked state at render gets no «Vin»; the preview still shows both buttons (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given two asking sends of an event, a person answering after the first and silent after the second, when «Mesaje trimise», the registrations list's chip, its filter «Reconfirmare» and the export are read then all say re-confirmed — a registration has re-confirmed when any of its asks is answered; «N-au răspuns» counts the still registered with no answered ask, «Au anulat după cerere» is unchanged, the history's numbers stay one grouped read and leave test registrations out (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given due rows of every kind on a road, when the outbox claims a batch then it takes, each step oldest first and in the room the steps before it left, a registration's own messages, then «Detalii actualizate», the reminder and the organizers' message (`SEND_TO_MANY_MESSAGE_TYPES`, a club copy with its type), then the bulk ones under their cap — in Gmail's carried path and for a press's own rows too, the batch handed to the worker in that order; a verification queued after 200 organizers' messages, a «Detalii actualizate» queued after the burst and a waiting-list offer queued after the reminder's 200 rows each leave first, the burst drains completely and none is sent twice; no row of the sends to many is capped, held or marked, so a row of theirs Mailgun paused, once due again, leaves Mailgun's road open, also when a daily allowance is spent (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send to many draining at the queue's pace — 201 organizers' messages or 200 reminders queued at 10:00 on a monthly plan, a pass every fifteen minutes — when `/api/health` is read at every pass then it answers `ok` until the last row leaves; a registration's own message whose turn passed by the allowance still reads `stalled`, an organizers' message a provider keeps refusing is still counted as retrying or failed, and the public «emailurile întârzie» neither counts such rows nor puts them ahead of a new registration's email (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send of 201 messages, when the question before «Trimite» is drawn then it is worded on the road the send takes, its club copy counted on its own road: on Mailgun with no daily ceiling, the pace, that it fits the month and «Emailurile înscrierilor pleacă înaintea lor.»; on Free's 100 a day with 5 sent, 95 today in about two hours, the other 106 over at least two more days at 100 a day, and a warning in the dialog and on the composer that it takes the daily allowance three days, that the registrations' own emails share it, and where a monthly plan is chosen; on the club's Gmail, Gmail's room, cap and pace and no Mailgun sentence (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 12 (amended): Given the composer, when a group is chosen, then it says how many emails the send costs on the road they take: against the Mailgun plan for what Mailgun carries, the club's copies included only when they go by Mailgun and said apart when they go by the club's Gmail; against Gmail's room in 24 hours, with no Mailgun allowance, for what the club's Gmail carries. When the room left is smaller, it says how many leave now and how many wait for the allowance or Gmail's room to come back. It never refuses the send for it (§40) (2026-09-24, `DECISIONS.md` §364; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 38 (amended): Given the outbox, when a public page asks whether the club's emails are late, then one query answers it (the rows not yet sent and those sent in the last ninety minutes, grouped by type and club copy, with the email plan and the transport setting), never counting the newsletter, the new-event alert, a send to many — «Detalii actualizate», the reminder and the organizers' message, which the claim takes after every registration's own message, and which are never counted ahead of it either —, the club's copies and archives, a staff or member invitation or a row a family's sitting holds — told only by its markers (`sittingHeld`, `familyHeld`, the family confirmation's `familySittingId`) while its not-before is ahead — and counting every other unsent row from its creation (a family's row, its hold over, from the instant it was let go, which the family's path records in the payload as `heldUntil` with every not-before it sets and rewrites to now at «Gata» — never from `next_attempt_at`, so a failed attempt after the release moves nothing; a marked row without it from its not-before when no provider gave a reason, else from its creation), a row handed to a later run (Gmail's pace, Mailgun's pause, a deferral) included, without the sending path writing anything new on any row; with an estimate that is never below when a spent hour frees its first place, a pause ends or an allowance resets, plus the scheduler's tick at that instant (the promised wait under the cadence then in force — the night's hour for a reset at 02:05 seen by day); it is served from the data cache under its own tag `public:email` for sixty seconds (a static page's render at the day's ceiling under its own key), with no saved copy; and `processOutboxBatch` expires that tag once per batch that sent, deferred, gave up on or withdrew a message, and never for a batch that claimed nothing or only scheduled a retry (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §623; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 39 (amended): Given one outbox claim with a limit — the batch size, the room Mailgun's hour leaves or the newsletter's cap — whatever the table's statistics say, an outbox emptied and vacuumed included, then it marks at most that many rows PROCESSING, in the claim's order — a registration's own messages first, then «Detalii actualizate», the reminder and the organizers' message, each oldest first: one `SELECT … LIMIT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` picks the ids and the UPDATE changes exactly those (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §644; amended 2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Cere reconfirmarea» with «Vin» and a ready reminder text; a staff send to many steps aside for the registrations' own emails
